packs.name: Quick Start
packs.description: Standard Turbo model with full pipeline — ready to generate in minutes. Best for most users.

packs.name: Minimal Setup
packs.description: Smallest viable setup — great for low-VRAM GPUs or quick testing.

packs.name: XL Quality
packs.description: XL Turbo model — larger architecture for richer, more detailed audio. Needs ~12GB VRAM.

packs.name: Blackwell Optimized
packs.description: MXFP4 quantised XL — native FP4 Tensor Core acceleration on RTX 5000 series. 22% faster than Q4.

packs.name: CUDA 13 Runtime
packs.description: NVIDIA CUDA 13.x runtime libraries required for GPU-accelerated generation. ~510 MB download.

packs.name: CUDA 12 Runtime
packs.description: NVIDIA CUDA 12.x runtime libraries for the CUDA 12.8 compatibility build. ~810 MB download.

packs.name: MiniMax-Music3 (F16)
packs.description: All five MiniMax-Music3 components at full precision — the reference quality bar. ~24 GB download.

packs.name: MiniMax-Music3 (Q8_0)
packs.description: LM, DiT and depth decoder at Q8_0 with the frontends near-native — near-lossless, about half the size and a faster LM step. Recommended. ~13 GB download.

packs.name: MiniMax-Music3 (Balanced mix)
packs.description: The split format's point: LM at Q8_0 (quality lives in the language model) with the DiT at Q4_K_M (VRAM lives in the flow stack), depth at Q8_0, frontends near-native. ~12 GB download.

packs.name: MiniMax-Music3 (Q6_K)
packs.description: LM and DiT at Q6_K, depth at Q8_0 (its validated floor), frontends near-native. ~10 GB download.

packs.name: MiniMax-Music3 (Q4_K_M)
packs.description: LM and DiT at Q4_K_M, depth at Q8_0, frontends near-native — the compact option for limited VRAM. ~8 GB download.

packs.name: MiniMax-Music3 (NVFP4)
packs.description: LM and DiT at NVFP4 — the FASTEST option measured (~18 ms/frame in the autoregressive stage vs ~117 for the K-quants) using Blackwell (RTX 50-series) native FP4 kernels; depth at Q8_0, frontends near-native. Quality is not yet judged by ear. ~8 GB download.

packs.name: MiniMax-Music3 Training
packs.description: Everything the Training Studio needs to train an MM3 artist adapter, on top of a generation pack. The two encoders turn your audio into codes; the F16 depth decoder is the one the trainer requires (the quantised depth files shipped with the generation packs are for generation only).

packs.name: MM3 TensorRT DiT
packs.description: The native TensorRT renderer for the MM3 Flow DiT: the ONNX graph plus the two core TensorRT runtime DLLs (nvinfer, ONNX parser). Weights are refit from whichever DiT GGUF you already have selected — this does not replace it. You also need ONE builder resource DLL matching your GPU's compute capability (SM); pick it separately in the TensorRT section of the Model Manager, since it depends on hardware this pack can't know in advance.

packs.name: Stem Separation
packs.description: All 3 models for multi-stem audio separation in Cover Studio. Required for the SuperSep pipeline.

packs.name: StableStep Separation (Leap Xe)
packs.description: BS-Roformer-Leap Xe vocal + instrumental pair for the StableStep pipeline. Native GGML, ~510 MB.

packs.name: Stem Separation cuDNN Libraries
packs.description: cuDNN libraries for GPU stem separation.

packs.name: Local Captioning (MOSS)
packs.description: Caption your own tracks locally in the Training Studio — MOSS listens to the audio instead of rewriting text. Also emits MM3 Structured Captions.

packs.name: YuE2 Recommended
packs.description: YuE2, a generation backend separate from ACE-Step and MiniMax-Music3: an autoregressive language model (plan/semantic/nar stages) plus a VAE decoder, producing 48 kHz stereo audio from a freeform style + lyrics prompt. Q8_0 LM (near-lossless: NAR-stage rel-L2 vs bf16 output 0.019, against bf16's own 0.013 baseline) plus the standard VAE and the companion decoder adapter. ~4.6 GB total. License: CC BY-NC 4.0, with the authors' clarification that individuals — creators, musicians, researchers — may use the model and its outputs freely, including commercially; only companies need a commercial license (gezhang@umich.edu).

packs.name: YuE2 INT8 ConvRot (CUDA)
packs.description: YuE2 ConvRot checkpoint for generation and Joint Training, plus a Q8_0 GGUF used for configuration and text tokenization and the standard VAE. Requires a CUDA build and an NVIDIA GPU with BF16 support (Ampere or newer). The GGUF remains a separate selectable generation option. ConvRot speed and audio quality should be compared on your hardware before choosing it as a default.

packs.name: YuE2 Full Precision
packs.description: YuE2 at source precision (BF16 LM) plus the standard VAE and the companion decoder adapter: the reference quality bar the whole quant ladder is measured against. Largest download and VRAM footprint of the four GGUF packs. ~7.9 GB total. License: CC BY-NC 4.0, with the authors' clarification that individuals — creators, musicians, researchers — may use the model and its outputs freely, including commercially; only companies need a commercial license (gezhang@umich.edu).

packs.name: YuE2-RS 4.0x0.7 (Ruach Studio)
packs.description: Ruach Studio's YuE2-RS 4.0x0.7 fine-tune of YuE2-3B (Q8_0 LM) plus the standard VAE and the companion decoder adapter. ~4.6 GB total. License: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (the fine-tune's own licence, share-alike), unlike the CC BY-NC of the other YuE2 packs. Credit: Ruach Studio, goldhub/YuE2-RS-Finetunes.

packs.name: YuE2 Compact (imatrix)
packs.description: YuE2 with the Q4_K_M-imat LM (imatrix-guided quantization; NAR-stage rel-L2 vs bf16 output 0.116, against bf16's own 0.013 baseline) plus the standard VAE and the companion decoder adapter. The usual choice for limited VRAM. ~3.1 GB total. License: CC BY-NC 4.0, with the authors' clarification that individuals — creators, musicians, researchers — may use the model and its outputs freely, including commercially; only companies need a commercial license (gezhang@umich.edu).

packs.name: YuE2 Tiny (imatrix)
packs.description: YuE2 with the smallest LM this ladder ships, Q2_K-imat, plus the standard VAE and the companion decoder adapter. WARNING: audibly degraded. NAR-stage rel-L2 vs bf16 output is 0.389 against bf16's own 0.013 baseline, the second-worst measurement on the whole ladder. Pick this only for the smallest possible download/VRAM footprint and expect the flow-matching output to sound rougher than every other pack. ~2.4 GB total. License: CC BY-NC 4.0, with the authors' clarification that individuals — creators, musicians, researchers — may use the model and its outputs freely, including commercially; only companies need a commercial license (gezhang@umich.edu).

packs.name: YuE2 Minted Regulariser Pack
packs.description: Optional training data for YuE2 artist (AR) LoRAs: mixes true YuE2 semantic codes into training so the adapter does not collapse into the encoder's adjacent-repeat defect. Not needed for generation, or for the NAR adapter trainer. About 91 MB.

packs.name: YuE2 Joint Training Pack
packs.description: Models for Joint Training (joint AR/NAR training): the raw ConvRot base, Q8_0 inference LM with text tokenizer, VAE encoder, semantic tokenizer and ABC transcriber. Requires a CUDA build and an NVIDIA GPU with BF16 support (Ampere or newer).

packs.name: YuE2 Artist (AR) Training Pack
packs.description: Everything ace-train needs to train a YuE2 artist adapter beyond the base LM: the semantic tokenizer that writes the codec targets the AR learns to predict, the MMS_FA aligner behind the lyric-cursor loss, the minted regulariser, and the SheetSage2 lead-sheet transcriber behind optional cot=full training. SheetSage2 also transcribes source audio for YuE2 covers; supplying an approved ABC score skips it.

packs.name: Stable Audio 3 Training
packs.description: SA3 DoRA-rows training and audition dependencies: BF16 Medium Base with its own conditioner, distilled generation DiT, SAME encoder/decoder, T5Gemma, tokenizer files and vocal-stripping models. Quantized base variants are experimental and are not supported training bases. Powered by Stability AI.

packs.name: heartmula-3b Q8_0 generation
packs.description: Matching global/local Q8_0 models, codec and tokenizer. Published GGUF components for native C++/GGML generation.

packs.name: heartmula-3b-happy-new-year Q8_0 generation
packs.description: Matching global/local Q8_0 models, codec and tokenizer. Published GGUF components for native C++/GGML generation.

packs.name: heartmula-3b-rl Q8_0 generation
packs.description: Matching global/local Q8_0 models, codec and tokenizer. Published GGUF components for native C++/GGML generation.

packs.name: HeartCodec optional encoder pack
packs.description: F16 MuEncoder, WavLM, Whisper and query fusion, plus shared RVQ. Optional for audio encoding; text generation does not load these.

packs.name: Stable Audio 3 generation
packs.description: Default BF16 generation DiT, SAME encoder/decoder, T5Gemma and tokenizer. Also used by StableStep. Powered by Stability AI.

packs.name: MIDI Transcription
packs.description: MuScriptor Small plus Beat This! for MIDI Studio (about 490 MB). MuScriptor is gated on Hugging Face: request access on its model page and save a read token before downloading. Medium and Large are optional.
